q: Resistors are said to be connected in series if they are connected in such a way that the same current flows through each resistor.
e: ဤသည် series circuit ၏ defining characteristic ဖြစ်သည်။

q: For resistors connected in series, the total potential difference $V$ is the sum of the individual potential differences: $V = V_1 + V_2 + V_3$.
e: Series circuit တွင် total voltage သည် resistor တစ်ခုချင်းစီ၏ voltage drops ပေါင်းခြင်းဖြစ်သည်။

q: The equivalent resistance $R$ of resistors connected in series is given by $R = R_1 + R_2 + R_3$.
e: ဤသည် series တွင် equivalent resistance တွက်ရန် မှန်ကန်သော formula ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The equivalent resistance of the resistors in series is equal to the sum of the resistances of the individual resistors.
e: ဤသည် series resistance combinations အတွက် general rule ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Resistors are said to be connected in parallel if they are connected in such a way that the same potential appears across each and every resistor.
e: ဤသည် parallel circuit ၏ defining characteristic ဖြစ်သည်။

q: For resistors connected in parallel, the total current $I$ is the sum of the individual currents: $I = I_1 + I_2 + I_3$.
e: Parallel circuit တွင် total current သည် branches များသို့ ခွဲပြီး branch currents ပေါင်းခြင်းဖြစ်သည်။

q: The equivalent resistance $R$ of resistors connected in parallel is given by $\frac{1}{R} = \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} + \frac{1}{R_3}$.
e: ဤသည် parallel တွင် equivalent resistance တွက်ရန် မှန်ကန်သော formula ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The reciprocal of the equivalent resistance of resistors connected in parallel is equal to the sum of the reciprocal of the individual resistances.
e: ဤသည် စာသားတွင် ဖော်ပြသော parallel resistance combinations အတွက် general rule ဖြစ်သည်။
